scope: Synthetic gate probes only; no Skill/code edits and no full rescore.

relevant_issues.message: supported claim 0 needs at least one packet support_evidence quote
numeric M6 requires an explicit claim inventory or confirmed no-third-party exception
source_items rank/query index disagrees with saved search row https://official.example/doc
M1 first hit query/rank does not match its source inventory row
M1 first hit must be explicitly reviewed as relevant official
possible_counts must equal derived admissible counts [1, 2]

interpretation.supported_m6_without_support_evidence: Rejected via m6.support; M11.score is a secondary stale-arithmetic consequence of changing M6 from 5 to 4 in the probe assessment.
interpretation.m6_null_writes_failure_report: Rejected and report was written; facts.m6 plus m6.claims issues are present.
interpretation.tampered_search_rank: Rejected via search.inventory; M1 first-hit issues are secondary effects of the same tamper.
interpretation.unknown_official_candidate_may_change_m5: Rejected via m5.counts with derived possible_counts [1, 2], so a numeric M5 cannot be accepted; M1 issues are secondary because the mutated item is the first official hit.

overall: All four requested misuse paths were mechanically rejected in the current implementation.
